predicates.predicate: A fresh verifier compiles the examples through javac or mvn, with offline flags where the repository provides a lock.
predicates.evidence: verify_java_examples compiles the product tree once per repository with an argfile and then each example as a classpath compile, under the disposable profile with JAVA_HOME derived from the resolved javac. No repository provides a lock and none needs one: the required-dependency set is empty for all four, so the whole verification is offline by construction and mvn was never invoked. 30 candidates, 25 compiled (3D 8/10, Cells 3/3, PDF 9/9, Slides 5/8); the five failures name a missing symbol in the example itself and match the aspose_org_upstream_issues digest for those products (3D's glTF/FBX/OBJ stubs).

predicates.predicate: Registry facts go through the vendored RegistryProbe (repo1.maven.org, never search.maven.org).
predicates.evidence: registry_facts calls surface.registry.observe, which reaches publication_probe's _maven_check and its https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/{group_path}/{artifact_id}/maven-metadata.xml template; search.maven.org is never touched. The reading is inconclusive for every Java package because observe's candidate carries only a name and _maven_check returns before it fetches when group_id or artifact_id is missing - PROPOSAL A, with the three-line fix. The plugin writes its own evidence sentence rather than the facade's 'answered ambiguously', so no candidate claims a read that did not happen.

proposals: A - extractors/surface/registry.py observe() cannot carry a Maven coordinate, so every Java install fact is UNRESOLVED; three lines; blocks all four repositories in two shapes.
B - core/ecosystems.py EcosystemSpec.badge() formats one {package}, which no Maven Central badge URL can use; the Java spec carries no version badge.
C - EcosystemSpec.floor_declaration is per ecosystem, but a POM states the Java floor as maven.compiler.release, .target or .source and this cohort uses all three.
D - reconciliation/dispositions.py normalize() errors instead of folding a placement into a deterministic section that renders nothing; the one impossible placement it does not fold.
E - composition/planning.py rejects a whole candidate for two trimmable ceiling breaches (duplicate api_hubs, Aspose links over the ceiling).
F - source_reconciliation is rejected whole for a coverage error a targeted re-ask would close (85 units; two missing, two duplicated).
G - authored prose leaks the phrase 'fact id' and BC-07 catches it at S9 after twelve calls; the one repair attempt records it unrepairable.
